title: Merge an approved immutable Site Change
description: Requests merge execution after an external review decision. Approval decides only whether the immutable artifact is approved; it does not decide technical merge eligibility. Site Change re-resolves Approval from fixed service configuration, requires an approved, integrity-valid, tenant/site-matching site_change artifact whose id, head version, and digest match this change, and independently verifies that GitHub's default branch still equals expected_base_sha. It never rebases or resolves conflicts automatically.
